g.text: W1 convergence: separate spatial, modal and temporal evidence
Actual Legume fields; geometry and modulation fixed. A passing layer does not certify the full model.
Wider modal windows introduce outgoing modes; exact BZ endpoint closure is also unresolved. Both remain explicit limits.
